records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/README.md
records.summary: Shantytown coordinates owned work for a crew through explicit capacity limits, tracker adapters, scheduled passes and recorded outcomes. Quipu integration remains optional.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fdesign.md
records.summary: Tracker and pane protocols separate work storage from session transport. Dispatch verification reads back delivery; refusal and dry-run outcomes preserve explicit uncertainty.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shantytown/shantytown%2Fcli.py
records.summary: st manages work, crew, repositories and jobs. Roles and anchors expose governed summaries; tend ranks proposals without reassignment. Failed reads stay UNKNOWN. Protected results use authenticated own-job mailboxes; signed reviews bind exact job and PR scope. Cycle accepts item-bound approved full-history custody only for an independently verified clean branch. Chaski delegation refuses local execution. Quarantined rank proposals require administrator acceptance; semantic-only benchmarks cannot admit rank decisions. Harness conversion retains per-harness model/browser preferences and reports unsupported fields. Measured CLI updates prefer checkpointed replacement; missing or stale native evidence stays UNKNOWN. Dispatch reports deterministic work overlap and measured cache usage with explicitly assumed model windows.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shantytown/shantytown%2Fconfig.py
records.summary: The configuration reader resolves shantytown.toml and declared environment settings. Local file-backed operation remains available independently of graph integration. The jobs.scheduler setting selects local execution by default or explicit Chaski delegation; invalid declarations and non-absence file-read errors refuse. Only an absent local file retains the built-in default behavior; best-effort supervision can report a fallback without granting local-job execution. Agent harness conversion retains validated per-harness model and browser preferences; unsupported optional fields are reported and omitted from launch commands. The inbox.store setting selects legacy seed pointers by default or the isolated Message graph; invalid or unknown declarations refuse. Cycle advice accepts per-model cache-window estimates; observed TTLs win.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fintegrations.md
records.summary: Optional Quipu, Seeds, Bobbin and Yupana integration supplies shared registry, work tracking, context and structural policy through configured adapters.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/CONTRIBUTING.md
records.summary: The package keeps zero runtime dependencies and Python 3.11 as its compatibility floor. Existing source checks and the built console entry point must remain verifiable.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/README.md
records.summary: Start with the public overview and dry-run crew preview before configuring a tracker or launching sessions.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fconfiguration.md
records.summary: Review root discovery, backend selection and declared settings before changing deployment configuration. The ranking advisory supports a named board-metrics query and preserves UNKNOWN for incomplete coverage.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/CONTRIBUTING.md
